questions.label: Structural Integrity
questions.guidance: Exterior walls, windows, and doors are checked for cracks, damage, weathering, leaks, or deterioration.

questions.label: Roofing & Drainage
questions.guidance: The roof and gutters show no visible damage, blockages, leaks, or loose sections; drainage areas are flowing freely without standing water.

questions.label: Decking & Pathways
questions.guidance: Decking and pathways are safe, level, and free from loose boards or trip hazards.

questions.label: Pool Health
questions.guidance: Swimming pool water is clean, equipment (pumps, filters) is functioning smoothly without excessive noise, and chemical levels are balanced.

questions.label: Air Conditioning
questions.guidance: Units cool efficiently to the required temperature without unusual noise or vibration. AC filters are clean and free from dust, with no water leakage from the indoor unit. The outdoor condenser is clean and unobstructed, and the drain line is flowing correctly.

questions.label: Fixtures & Fittings
questions.guidance: Sliding doors open and close smoothly, and locks function correctly. The ceiling fan is balanced, clean, and operating quietly. Bed bases are structurally sound, clean, and free from damage or squeaks.

questions.label: Electrical Interfaces
questions.guidance: DND/Service switches are working correctly and clearly illuminated. Plug bases are operational, secure, and undamaged.

questions.label: Water Pressure & Leaks
questions.guidance: The shower holder, hose, and shower head exhibit no leaks, blockages, corrosion, or low water pressure. The sink, sink table, and bottle trap show no leaks, damage, or corrosion.

questions.label: Fittings & Hardware
questions.guidance: Door hinges and screws are tight, rust-free, and operating quietly. The bathtub has no stains, chips, cracks, or drainage issues.

questions.label: Seals & Finishes
questions.guidance: Grouting and silicone are clean, mould-free, and intact.

questions.label: Equipment Functionality
questions.guidance: All heavy kitchen equipment (ovens, fryers, stoves, grills) are fully operational. Refrigerators and freezers are maintaining correct temperatures with intact door seals.

questions.label: Ventilation & Exhaust
questions.guidance: Extractor hoods and ventilation systems are functioning properly, with filters clean and free of heavy grease build-up.

questions.label: Gas Safety
questions.guidance: Gas lines, manifolds, and cylinder storage areas are secure, leak-free, and comply with safety standards.

questions.label: Drainage & Hygiene
questions.guidance: Floor drains and grease traps are clean, unblocked, and functioning without foul odors.

questions.label: Machinery Health
questions.guidance: Washing machines and tumble dryers are operating smoothly without unusual vibrations, noise, or leaks. Lint traps are clean.

questions.label: Chemical Dosing & Water Supply
questions.guidance: Chemical dosing systems (if applicable) are functioning correctly. Water supply lines are secure and pressure is adequate for industrial cycles.

questions.label: Ventilation & Safety
questions.guidance: The laundry area is well-ventilated, and electrical connections for heavy machinery are secure and safe.

questions.label: Water Treatment (RO Plants)
questions.guidance: Reverse Osmosis (RO) plants are functioning efficiently. Filter replacement logs are up to date, and water quality testing results are within acceptable parameters.

questions.label: Sewerage Treatment Plants (STP)
questions.guidance: The STP is operating correctly without blockages, overflows, or excessive odors. Aeration pumps and transfer systems are functional.

questions.label: Solar Systems (Hot Water & PV)
questions.guidance: Solar hot water panels/tubes are clean and intact, providing adequate hot water. Solar PV systems (if installed) are generating power, inverters are error-free, and panels are free of debris.

questions.label: Backup Power (Generators)
questions.guidance: The standby generator starts smoothly, fuel levels are adequate, battery health is good, and the changeover switch (ATS) functions correctly.

questions.label: Power Distribution
questions.guidance: The Electrical Distribution Board (DB) is accessible, labelled correctly, clean, and secure.

questions.label: Fire & Safety
questions.guidance: Smoke detectors are tested and functioning correctly. Electronic fire alarm batteries are replaced annually. Fire extinguishers are serviced and accessible.

questions.label: Security Hardware
questions.guidance: Electronic safe servicing is up to date, ensuring batteries are replaced on a quarterly basis.
